author: PCarme
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:** PTHR12599 ; PTN000287870 

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** PTN000287952 ; SPAC27D7.04 ; omt2

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue** erroneous propagation

(from https://github.com/pombase/curation/issues/3919#issuecomment-4023178189)

omt2 doesn't appear to actually be a pterin-4a-carbinolamine dehydratase. Phylogenetic study (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18245455/) in plants and microorganisms characterised its potential pterin-4a-carbinolamine dehydratase domain as non-canonical, stating that it is unlikely to actually have this activity.
Additionally, this activity is involved in tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism, which is absent in S. pombe (see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31696).

cc @ValWood
